hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const i=JSON.parse(d);const cmd=(i.tool_input&&i.tool_input.command)||'';if(/\bgit\s+commit\b/.test(cmd)&&/#\s*via:my-commit\s*$/.test(cmd)){console.log(JSON.stringify({hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:'PreToolUse',permissionDecision:'ask',permissionDecisionReason:'請確認 commit message 內容'}}))}}catch(e){}})"
